meets: The kit pick has plainer words and still cannot be understood: "Build", the Shift tag and the tree diagram are never explained, both cards end with the same sentence, and the cards speak in the game's own terms ("Vault kicks zap what's near", "Mount walls from twice as far", "Vaults restore jumps. Heavy fins steer harder."). The same pick returns after a death, and it was that reader's second complaint. One reader of four called a pick screen clear (the second pick, 078-080)

Three prompts still show an icon and no word: the Shift icon as the run starts, an E prompt in the flume's crew fight, the mouse and Shift icons in Brindle's fight (E MOUNT, HOOK, Space SLINGSHOT, Ctrl SLAM and Q ULTIMATE now read)

The camera sits on the ball in a fight: the ball fills a third to a half of the view in the dam Warden fight and a quarter in Brindle's, a pillar or a wall blocks a third to a half of it, and the camera ends inside Brindle's bow. All three first-timer readers said they could not see the fight (the bot aims the camera at its target and never frames the view, so the PC film decides)

A pale see-through cone from the sky covers the middle of the view on the way into the dam yard. It is the wall-kick aim mark coming back over the camera when the ball is in the air beside a steep face. #715 cut its flat fill to a short root; the PC then read 12 percent of the middle of the view facing a wall and 17 to 21 percent on a mount at full slingshot charge, with heavy dashed lines near the camera. The second fix draws one dashed line in place of three, starts it and the root at the ball's edge, fades the mark near the camera and takes the kick's mark down on a mount (it was a stale record). The cloud reads 4 to 5 percent on the PC's box where the last build read 8 to 17. The row closes when the PC's re-film reads 8 percent or less at all four poses and a film shows no reader the cone

At the start of a second run the CLOCKED IN stamp lands on Moss's message box, which cannot be read, and the stage's name line is too faint (on a first run a gained part's name now rides above the ball and no longer prints over the prompt)

RUN OVER names the cause and gives a useful tip, but its stats still do not explain themselves: "COGS LEFT 922" beside "SCRAP HELD 935" (the reader could not say the difference or whether either is kept), "PARTS 2", "EVENTS WON 0", and the line "Shift board: CLOCKED IN; Warden Breaker (LOGGED)"; the comic's captions are too small to read
Nothing confirms which kit card was taken: the picture after the pick is the same as the one before, and nothing on the next screens names the kit (the packed part does show its name over the ball)

The pickup line in giant letters (DRUM +6% CRUISE SPEED, FIN +3%) lies across the dam Warden fight and hides behind the Warden. It is held to 60 percent of the view in this film. The smaller cap (#719) stacked after it; the PC reel decides whether that is enough

A warning now shows before each hit (a red !, for a single picture before the silt boil), but no reader could say where safe ground was or which way to move. The ! sits on the lock-on and reads as a target mark, the attack's orange outline looks like the yard walls, and nothing shows whether a ring is growing or closing. Hit six times: silt boil 30, lobber 18 three times (the readers took these for the Warden's attack), Brindle's slag 24, Brindle's charge 23

Pop-ups pile up during action in every part of the run, full of names nobody explains: New record, New B-side, Achievement, New look, field note, synergy and fleet grade cards (three readers listed the unexplained names among their five complaints). The kit pick fades in over a hit word, the reward crate dims the screen during Brindle's chase, and the card about crane magnets arrives after that part of the fight is over. The radio also changes station by itself in a boss fight (HEAT 101.3) and nothing says so
Speech cards and warning lines too faint to read: the "Warden on the dam." card and "Toe Vents Wake incoming" (Moss's "You're riding low" box now reads)

The ability row does not explain itself: it fades out in the middle of a fight, the Ctrl slot goes grey with no reason, a big "2" or "3" stands beside F, and the counters (715, 200, 1429) have no label. The flume Warden's bar squares read as progress to one reader; Brindle's reader could not explain his bar's squares and diamonds

Reward gates: each gate now says what it gives and one reader called them clear, but the labels still sit by the ball and not on the gates, and the reward words are the game's own terms ("Bank a bigger plant", "Rebounds deal a weapon hit"). The rebound gate's sign, which read as a tick, passed on the PC after this film: a hop ending in a dot over a floor line
A shell's flight trace, the chain of pink squares that warns of a lobbed shot, was taken for placeholders; no reader read it as a warning

The player's own hit words cover the fight: BWAP, WHUMP and KRUNCH on a grown build stand 17 percent of the view's height against 7.5 for an ordinary one, sit on the boss or the ball, and print over other words; Brindle's HONK and FURNACE LIT over KA-CHUNK cover him too, and ZWOOSH lies flat on the sand. Split from PF-14; the PC film decides

See-through shapes cover the view: in the dam Warden fight and the flume's crew fight the attack marks (dark and orange frames, rings) cross most of the screen, so a reader could not find the ball or the boss, and at the flume's launch the stacked rings round the ball fill the view. It was one reader's worst complaint. How solid the shapes look depends on the renderer, so the PC film decides

The lime landmark beam at the dam reads as a wall when the ball is beside it: at about 50 m its flat, unshaded, bright lime core, 3 m wide with hard edges, fills the view like a solid face (src/presentation/landmark_beam.gd, as built). Seen on the PC; no blind reader has read it. The fix is planned for after the sitting: the core eases out with nearness and gets a soft edge, picked from candidates with a PC look

The Rivet Plating part says "Bolt on armour" and its panel says "+15 max health", while the bar marked ARMOUR is empty before and after it: three readers could not match the card to a bar. Either the bar is meant to start empty and the part's words are the fault (src/build/parts.gd), or the bar should have filled
